captions.detailed: A road double crankset assembly consisting of a central bottom bracket spindle housing, two gray aluminum alloy crank arms oriented 180 degrees apart, a 5-bolt spider, and two black anodized chainrings (one large outer ring and one smaller inner ring). Two black textured pedals are attached to the ends of the crank arms via thin spindles. The main crank spindle and both crank arms rotate in unison continuously around the central axis, while each individual pedal rotates continuously relative to its respective crank arm.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a road double crankset with a central spindle, two crank arms, two chainrings (large and small) mounted to a 5-bolt spider, and two pedals. Ensure the spindle and crank assembly rotates continuously, and each pedal has a continuous rotational joint at the end of its crank arm.
captions.factory: The code constructs a central spindle housing using a cylinder. It builds the crank arms by extruding a rounded slot profile and adding cylindrical bosses. The 5-bolt spider is generated by polar-patterning cylindrical arms and connector pins. The chainrings are created by extruding a circle, subtracting a center hole, and subtracting patterned triangular cuts to form the gear teeth. The pedals are modeled by extruding a rectangular block with small ridges on top. Continuous joints are then defined to link the spindle, crank arms, and pedals together.
